scenarios.expected: Symptom checks lead to supported recovery or specific escalation without access bypass or unsupported provider claims.
scenarios.actual: Read the escalation the article routes to this reader. On the request naming Nadia Haddad the requesting Administrator was offered only "Cancel request"; on the request naming himself he was offered Approve, Reject and Cancel request. He opened a Confidential Contract he did not create, added the Contributor team entry that recovered another reader's access, and reached the integrations settings where the connector state is read. Help and the formal reader reached all three guides and their recovery links.

scenarios.expected: Symptom checks lead to supported recovery or specific escalation without access bypass or unsupported provider claims.
scenarios.actual: Followed the symptom families that reach this reader. A wrong password answered "Check your email and password." and left the account usable. An over-long filename was refused with copy naming the filename problem, nothing was stored, and the corrected name uploaded exactly once in the destination list. A deliberately damaged archive named .docx showed "Preparing this document for reading…" and then "This file could not be prepared for reading here. Download it to read it.", while Download returned the original 2,058 bytes and no Version was appended. The preference pane carried the In-app and Email switches, a Briefing section, and the app's own sentence "In-app off turns the group off entirely, email included." The named approver decided once through a dialog that says "A decision is final. To change it, ask for a new approval.", and no decision control remained afterwards. Moving past Approval with one unresolved request raised the "Move past approval" warning, and Cancel left the Status on Draft. Signing offered no send control and no Analysis surface existed, so both symptoms ended at the configuration escalation the article names.

scenarios.expected: Symptom checks lead to supported recovery or specific escalation without access bypass or unsupported provider claims.
scenarios.actual: Started from the article's missing-record symptom. A direct link to a Confidential Contract with no team entry answered "Something went wrong." with a Reload control, leaked no record title, and did not change on a second Reload. After the Administrator added the qualifying team entry the same link opened the record, so the refusal was access and not deletion. The Entities module stayed closed. On the shared Contract there was no Add approver, no Apply group and no Add task, so the article's instruction to ask Legal for the legal action is the only route the app leaves open. Nothing in the article offered a way around any refusal.

scenarios.expected: Symptom checks lead to supported recovery or specific escalation without access bypass or unsupported provider claims.
scenarios.actual: Followed the Portal symptoms. A Portal sign-in link worked once and was refused on reuse with the app's expired or already-used wording, which is the article's "request a new link and open the newest message" recovery. Notification settings in the Portal offered "Request updates". A staff Contract workspace stayed closed to this reader. Portal Help listed all three reference guides and their recovery links resolved.
